faqsIntro.headline: Frequently asked questions
faqsIntro.sub: Answers about demos, sizing and support.

faqs.a: Our team shows SecuEdge Frontier set up correctly in Quick Mode, answers your questions, and recommends the right model for your user count.

faqs.q: How do I choose a model?
faqs.a: Choose by how many people use your network at the busiest time, counting each VPN user three times. Use the model finder or ask our team.

faqs.q: What kind of support is included?
faqs.a: 24/7 technical support from India-based engineers on 1800 123 0966. We respond within 24 hours. Regular updates and quarterly security reviews are included.

faqs.q: Can SecuEdge Frontier work with our existing network?
faqs.a: Yes. SecuEdge Frontier sits at your internet edge and works with your existing switches and Wi-Fi. Our team handles the setup.

faqs.q: Do I need a network engineer to run it?
faqs.a: No. Quick Mode is built for business owners and IT generalists. Engineers can switch to Professional Mode at any time.
